doctrine: 0 means 'I accept your judgment' and may be 80%+ of presses — that itself is learnable. Keys replay SELECTION, never authorization: a 0-accept on AUTHORIZATION replays which option was chosen, never a standing approval. Macros replay selection, never authorization.
modes: IDLE (no open questions): 0 acts as GO, 7 with no text target files a correction, 8 shows goal. QUESTION (open questions): 0 accepts the recommendation, 1-7 pick options, 8 expands the question, 9 stops. Mode rides in every press row.

0.name: ACCEPT
0.acts: Accept the recommendation: answer the open question with its recommended option (or approve if none). Nothing open = GO (drain ready).

1.name: GO
1.acts: List the READY set as orders. Agent drains them; questions surface on block.

2.name: ZOOM
2.acts: Achieved-vs-missing across queue, humans, goal, spend. Read-only.

3.name: DIG
3.acts: Show current blockers (open questions + NOGO reasons). Bounded, read-only.

4.name: PICK
4.acts: Answer the open question with option 1-7.

5.name: OK
5.acts: Approve the first open question. Spend re-resolves its gate.

6.name: NO
6.acts: Deny the first open question; the task replans around it.

7.name: TELL
7.acts: Answer the open question with text (key-shaped input refused). No open question = file a correction.

8.name: MORE
8.acts: Expand: full detail of the open question, else goal progress. Read-only.

9.name: STOP
9.acts: Halt (writes HALT.json) or resume (lifts it). Read-only keys 2,3,8 still work under halt.

grammar: Digits are verbs. Only 4 consumes a following digit as its argument (option 1-7). 7 opens text capture. Anything else is a ValueError, never a guess.
never_autonomous: 0-accept on AUTHORIZATION (money/destructive re-resolves its gate), key-shaped TELL payloads. Hard exclusion, not a threshold.
